Two equal-weight map clusters, report both within-map seat means and their range; inference about a population or other opponents is out of scope. Eight games are diagnostic only. Results never enter the existing v1 fit, any stage of model selection or its Master3s2 win numerator.
resources: One isolated CPU for gameplay and replay during an authorized native-queue gap. BLAS/OMP one thread. Resume only missing units with hash-bound immutable game receipts.
